summary: Registered users can reset a forgotten password by requesting a reset link sent to their registered email address and setting a new password.
preconditions: User has an account with a registered email address
acceptance_criteria: User can request a password reset by submitting their registered email
A password reset link is sent to the registered email
User can set a new password using a valid reset link
A request for an email that is not registered does not reset any password
business_rules: A reset link can be used only once
A reset link expires after a limited time
edge_cases: Email entered with different letter casing
Reset link used a second time
risk_areas: Account enumeration through different responses for registered and unregistered emails
ambiguities: Reset link expiry duration is not specified
Password complexity rules are not specified
Rate limiting of reset requests is not specified
